title: The Global T20 Nomad: CH Gayle's Journey Across 6 Leagues
summary: CH Gayle has played in 6 T20 leagues (BBL, BPL, CPL, IPL, PSL), scoring 11920 runs at 35.1.
body:
## 6 Leagues, One Mission

CH Gayle is one of T20 cricket's true globetrotters. From the IPL to the BBL, from the CPL to the PSL, he's plied his trade across **6 different T20 leagues**: BBL, BPL, CPL, IPL, PSL, T20I.

**Career Numbers:** 11920 runs | 388 innings | Avg 35.1 | SR 142.3

That kind of cross-league experience shapes a player. Different pitches, different pressure, different tactical demands — and Gayle has delivered across all of them.

*Data across 6 T20 leagues. Analysis by MatchPrism.*
